title: 9.2 Special Right Triangles

icans: I can find the side lengths of a 45°-45°-90° triangle from one side.
I can find the side lengths of a 30°-60°-90° triangle from one side.
I can use special right triangles to solve real-life problems.

vocab: an ____________ right triangle; its two legs are congruent
a right triangle with __________ of 30°, 60°, and 90°; half of an equilateral triangle
in a 30°-60°-90° ___________, the leg across from the 30° angle

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: fold the special triangles

blocks.p: Square: fold it on a diagonal. The right triangle has angles 45°, 45°, 90°.
Equilateral triangle: fold it in half along an altitude. The right triangle has angles 30°, 60°, 90°.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: 45°-45°-90° Triangle Theorem: the hypotenuse is _______________ times as long as each leg: hypotenuse = leg · √2.

blocks.stem: Find the length of the hypotenuse.

notes: From the hypotenuse: to find a leg, _______________ the hypotenuse by √2, then rationalize.

blocks.stem: The hypotenuse of a 45°-45°-90° triangle is 10. Find the length of each leg.

notes: 30°-60°-90° Triangle Theorem: the hypotenuse is _______________ times the shorter leg, and the longer leg is _______________ times the shorter leg.

blocks.stem: The shorter leg of a 30°-60°-90° triangle is 6. Find the hypotenuse and the longer leg.

notes: Shorter leg first: in a 30°-60°-90° triangle, always find the _______________ leg first.
